<quote by="Proposed: Karov, Seconded: Karsk">Ratify treaty with the Druj sept known as Coiled Krait
</quote>
==Overview==
* Ratifies a [[Ambassador#Treaty|treaty]] with a group of the Druj
* Failed

==Date==
* Summer 387YE

==The Treaty==
<big><u>Treaty with the Coiled Krait formerly of the Banded Snake clan, Summer 387YE</u></big><br>

<big>We the Empire:</big><br>
Declare the Coiled Krait to be foreigners with all the protections of Imperial law<br>
Cede a town. There, they will be allowed to establish homes and live freely as foreigners, safe from the ravages of their kinfolk

<big>The Coiled Krait:</big><br>
Will offer information of military significance to the Empire to assist in their campaign in the [[Sarangrave]].<br>
They will not take up arms against the Druj, but will offer whatever other help they are able to in this season before leaving for their new home.<br>
The Coiled Krait agree to be bound by all Imperial laws and will end the practice of slavery amongst their people when they cross the border into Imperial lands.
